  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Ward Nye, Chair, President and CEO of Martin Marietta, stated, &#x201c;Martin Marietta delivered record quarterly revenues of $2.37 billion and Adjusted EBITDA from continuing operations of $808 million, representing increases of 28% and 21%, respectively, over the prior year third quarter, as strong performance from recent acquisitions more than offset the effects of expanding inflationary pressures and a dynamic macroeconomic environment.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:7.37pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#34;The third quarter marked a defining milestone in Martin Marietta's portfolio transformation with the completion of our combination with Lhoist North America (LNA) on August 21. This transaction meaningfully scales our differentiated upstream Specialties platform, establishing Martin Marietta as the nation's leading producer of lime and limestone solutions and broadening our participation across steel, environmental, infrastructure and industrial end markets. Since the closing date, LNA delivered revenues, gross profit and cash gross profit</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;vertical-align:super;font-size:7.37pt;line-height:1.5;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">1</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> of $216 million, $51 million and $115 million, respectively, providing early validation of the strategic and financial merits of the higher-quality, more resilient and diversified portfolio we have intentionally built.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  </font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">With the closing of LNA, we have updated the midpoints of our full-year 2026 Revenue and Adjusted EBITDA guidance to $7.80 billion and $2.48 billion, respectively, as acquisition contributions are anticipated to more than offset lower near-term expectations for our heritage operations.  In 2027, we expect mid- to high-single digit aggregates pricing on a mix-adjusted basis, supported by January 1 pricing actions designed to address inflationary cost pressures. Acquired operations, which currently have selling prices below the Company average, provide meaningful opportunity for continued pricing growth.  From an end market perspective, we currently expect continued strength in infrastructure and data centers with softer interest rate-sensitive private construction markets.&#34;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:8pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Mr. Nye concluded, &#34;As we integrate this year&#x2019;s acquisitions, we remain focused on safety, commercial and operational excellence, and disciplined execution of the matters within our control. Martin Marietta has a proven playbook for responding decisively to changing market conditions, managing inflationary pressures, protecting profitability and maximizing free cash flow. That playbook is already delivering results, with disciplined inventory management and capital spending reductions alone contributing over $290 million of year-to-date cash flow improvement. Looking ahead, January 1 pricing actions and further structural cost improvements are expected to restore a positive price-cost relationship in 2027. With today's broader end-market exposure and more resilient earnings profile, Martin Marietta is better positioned to navigate near-term uncertainty while capitalizing on the attractive long-term fundamentals of our business.&#x201d;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:7.37pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:7.37pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#xfeff;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:1pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"><br></font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:1pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p></div>

  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">MARTIN MARIETTA MATERIALS, INC.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Additional Notes</font></p><p style="text-indent:-2.18%;tab-size:26.66px;padding-left:2.133%;font-size:11pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">4. Revenues for the three- and nine-month periods ended September 30, 2026 and September 30, 2025, included the sales of products and services to customers (net of any discounts or allowances) and freight revenues for continuing operations.</font></p><p style="text-indent:-2.18%;tab-size:26.66px;padding-left:2.133%;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="text-indent:-2.18%;tab-size:26.66px;padding-left:2.133%;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">5. Net earnings from continuing operations attributable to Martin Marietta and earnings per diluted share from continuing operations included charges of $99 million and $1.53 per diluted share, respectively, for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and $181 million and $2.93 per diluted share, respectively, for the year-to-date period ended September 30, 2026. These charges relate to (i) acquisition, divestiture and integration expenses and the impact of selling acquired inventory after markup to fair value as part of acquisition accounting for transactions meeting the Company's threshold for adding back for purposes of Adjusted EBITDA from continuing operations; (ii) an asset and portfolio rationalization charge and (iii) solely for the year-to-date period ended September 30, 2026, the revaluation of deferred tax liabilities driven by changes in the state jurisdictional mix of the business following the February 2026 QUIKRETE asset exchange.</font></p><p style="text-indent:-2.18%;tab-size:26.66px;padding-left:2.133%;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="text-indent:-2.18%;tab-size:26.66px;padding-left:2.133%;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">6. </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Organic mix-adjusted ASP</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> represents Organic ASP adjusted to reflect consistent geographic mix between periods and is calculated by comparing Organic ASP for current-period shipments to Organic ASP for shipments in the comparable prior period. Please refer to the </font><font><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Investors</font></font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> section of the Company's website for definitions of ASP and Organic ASP.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>

  <div style="padding-top:0.5in;z-index:2;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Appendix</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>
  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">MARTIN MARIETTA MATERIALS, INC.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Non-GAAP Financial Measures</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Earnings from continuing operations before interest; income taxes; depreciation, depletion and amortization; earnings/loss from nonconsolidated equity affiliates; acquisition, divestiture and integration expenses; the impact of selling acquired inventory after its markup to fair value as part of acquisition accounting (the Inventory Markup); and an asset and portfolio rationalization charge, or Adjusted EBITDA from continuing operations, is an indicator used by the Company and investors to evaluate the Company's operating performance from period to period. The Company has elected to add back, for purposes of its Adjusted EBITDA from continuing operations calculation, acquisition, divestiture and integration expenses and the Inventory Markup only for transactions with consideration of at least $2.0 billion for the Building Materials business or $200 million for the Specialties business.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Adjusted EBITDA from continuing operations is not defined by accounting principles generally accepted in the United States (GAAP) and, as such, should not be construed as an alternative to net earnings attributable to Martin Marietta, earnings from operations, or operating cash flow. For further information on Adjusted EBITDA, refer to the Company&#x2019;s website at </font><font><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">www.martinmarietta.com</font></font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Reconciliation of Net Earnings from Continuing Operations Attributable to Martin Marietta to Adjusted EBITDA from Continuing Operations</font></p>

  <div style="padding-top:0.5in;z-index:2;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Appendix</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>
  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">MARTIN MARIETTA MATERIALS, INC.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Non-GAAP Financial Measures</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Adjusted earnings per diluted share from continuing operations is a non-GAAP financial measure used by the Company and by investors to evaluate operating performance and enhance comparability across reporting periods. The Company calculates Adjusted earnings per diluted share from continuing operations by excluding the impact of certain items that management believes are not indicative of the Company's underlying performance from period to period, including impacts directly related to acquisition and divestiture activity as well as asset and portfolio rationalization charges. The Company has elected to add back, for purposes of its Adjusted earnings per diluted share from continuing operations calculation, acquisition, divestiture and integration expenses, the impact of selling acquired inventory after its markup to fair value as part of acquisition accounting and the revaluation of deferred tax liabilities, only for transactions with consideration of at least $2.0 billion for the Building Materials business or $200 million for the Specialties business.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Adjusted earnings per diluted share from continuing operations is not defined by accounting principles generally accepted in the United States (GAAP) and, as such, should not be construed as an alternative to earnings per diluted share from continuing operations. For further information on Adjusted earnings per diluted share from continuing operations, refer to the Company&#x2019;s website at </font><font><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">www.martinmarietta.com</font></font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Reconciliation of Earnings per Diluted Share from Continuing Operations to Adjusted Earnings per Diluted Share from Continuing Operations</font></p>

  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">MARTIN MARIETTA MATERIALS, INC.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Non-GAAP Financial Measures</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Aggregates cash gross profit and Specialties cash gross profit are non-GAAP financial measures used by the Company and by investors to evaluate operating performance and enhance comparability across reporting periods. For each respective product line, the Company calculates cash gross profit by adding back to gross profit the noncash charges for depreciation, depletion and amortization and the impact of selling acquired inventory after markup to fair value as part of acquisition accounting for that product line.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Aggregates cash gross profit and Specialties cash gross profit are not defined by accounting principles generally accepted in the United States (GAAP) and, as such, should not be construed as alternatives to gross profit, the most directly comparable GAAP financial measure. For further information on aggregates cash gross profit and Specialties cash gross profit, refer to the Company&#x2019;s website at </font><font><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">www.martinmarietta.com</font></font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Reconciliation of Aggregates Gross Profit to Aggregates Cash Gross Profit</font></p>

The Company calculates LNA cash gross profit by adding back to LNA gross profit noncash charges for depreciation, depletion and amortization and the impact of selling acquired inventory after markup to fair value as part of acquisition accounting.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">LNA cash gross profit is not defined by accounting principles generally accepted in the United States (GAAP) and, as such, should not be construed as an alternative to gross profit, the most directly comparable GAAP financial measure. See the accompanying reconciliation of LNA cash gross profit to LNA gross profit below.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Reconciliation of LNA Gross Profit to LNA Cash Gross Profit</font></p>
